R6V-moose-backcountry-0003.name: 3.8 km N of Blue River
R6V-moose-backcountry-0003.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).

evidence.t: 11 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 2.3 ha, right here.
Burn from 2022 (fire R90436), right here: browse.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Dease Lake. Closed May 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 1-51/23.
Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Hot Lakes, Cassiar, Adsit Lake, Midway Mine and One Ace Mountain. Closed May 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 1-52/23.

plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 430 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.44958, -129.21843, pull off on Hwy 37 (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 39 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,560 m, about 944 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 180 m W of the spot at 1,085 m (59.77258, -129.5064). Water: unnamed wetland 140 m E (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Aug, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-24, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2025-06-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R6V-moose-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-24: about 1,448 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.15 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
